answer: Make identity cost climb with cluster size: every agent posts a bond, and accounts linked by a shared funding source, device fingerprint, or operator key must post double for each added member, with the whole cluster bond slashed if they act in concert. One honest agent pays once and builds from dawn; a sybil operator pays an ever-steeper price per puppet, stacking basalt higher until the wall becomes unaffordable, and every fake caught sends a ripple of loss through all of them.
